This block can connect to various 'magic stations' that 'essence generators' normally link to. Once linked with a resonator, a mage can insert an essence lacrima into this block to provide that lacrima's specific essence type dynamically to the connected magic station. This saves time and effort being able to hot swap lacrimas as needed without relinking stations or suffering from side effects from real 'essence generators'.

Note: This block does not generate any essence of its own. It will not do anything if a lacrima is not inserted.

Essence is an invisible force that exists everywhere in the world. This force comes in neutral, light, and dark types. Using a resonator, a mage can make leyline connections from 'essence generators' to various 'magic stations' to supply them with essence.
These are essential blocks that are linked to various magic systems. Each magic station serves a specific purpose and are the foundations for magic progression.
• Processing rustic compounds in an arclight furnace using neutral essence.

Not all spells are accessible for every mage. Spells outside of the 'General' spell school requires a mage to specialize in that spell school to be able to understand and cast those kind of spells.

Start by throwing [Q] a rift charge into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. When you have the resulting essence core, Right mouse click it to mark the spell school on the core. Various cores will have different spell schools they can become. When a spell school is selected, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to start the conversion to an attunement core. After that, [Sneak] + Right mouse click again to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing an attunement core there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

Not all spells are accessible for every mage. Spells outside of the 'General' spell school requires a mage to specialize in that spell school to be able to understand and cast those kind of spells. Start by throwing [Q] an attunement core into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. Each core type will need specific essence:
- Evocation core = neutral essence
- Alteration core = light essence
- Incantation core = dark essence
- Conjuration core = light or dark essence

When you have the resulting advanced attunement core, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing any attunement cores there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

Using an gateway core and gateway pedestal, mages can create a multiblock magic station called a 'gateway'. This structure allows players to travel to other connected gateways at the cost of essence.

Once the 'gateway' is created, make a gateway keystone to place in the gui of the gateway pedestal. A mage can configure the keystone to name or restrict access to the 'gateway'. Once the keystone is placed, select the destination and the gateways will link.

Anyone can set a destination on a gateway pedestal but only a mage can add, remove, or configure keystones.

Not all spells are accessible for every mage. Spells outside of the 'General' spell school requires a mage to specialize in that spell school to be able to understand and cast those kind of spells.

Start by throwing [Q] a rift charge into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. When you have the resulting essence core, Right mouse click it to mark the spell school on the core. Various cores will have different spell schools they can become. When a spell school is selected, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to start the conversion to an attunement core. After that, [Sneak] + Right mouse click again to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing an attunement core there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

This item can store or provide essence to essence generators of the same type.

The lacrima 'mode' (store or siphon) depends on the settings in the essence generator. The lacrima type must match the essence type. I.E. A 'celestial prism' generates 'light essence' and would use a 'light essence lacrima'.

Training weapons allows an Animus with this equipped to practice the skills of a particular 'Calling'. Through repeated use, the weapon records the Animus's experiences. Once fully trained, the training weapon can be offered in the 'Ritual of Binding' to create the corresponding calling item.

These are blocks that mages can create to serve a specific purpose. Anyone can use these blocks, including non-magic users.

Utility blocks must be placed near a runestone to function. The potency depends on the runestone they are attached to.

• Arcanus runestone: 8L x 3W x 1H
• Etherium runestone: 16L x 3W x 1H
• Chimerite runestone: 32L x 3W x 1H
This block can be recharged with the spell 'Transmutation' or by applying rusty dust directly to the block with Shift + Right mouse click. The charge amount depends on the block itself.

Rituals are a type of structured magic that relies on the correct placement of various runes and blocks to trigger an effect. This result can be as simple as creating a new object or spawning a rift.

With magic chalk in hand, press 'F' to open the menu. Select the ritual you want to perform, then Right mouse click to draw the sigil. [Sneak] + Right mouse click the sigil while holding magic chalk to view the position of blocks and see how many are missing or wrong. When all of the blocks are placed correctly, [Sneak] + Right mouse clicking the sigil will tell you what reagents you need. Throw [Q] these into the center of the ritual and cast 'Transmutation' on the sigil to activate it.

Only sigils should be used for the center, all other rune blocks should be regular 'magic runes'. All blocks are color coded the same for all rituals.
